hints.title: Zero-Padding Equivalence
hints.text: Two numbers can be transformed into one another with at most one digit swap if their equal-length zero-padded representations differ at zero or exactly two positions with transposed digits.

hints.title: Pairwise Position Comparison
hints.text: Pad both numbers with leading zeros to the maximum length of either number and locate indices with mismatched characters.

hints.title: Swap Validation
hints.text: If exactly two positions differ and their characters match reciprocally, they form an almost equal pair.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Pairwise checks on digit strings of length up to 7.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Higher-order permutations are unnecessary when single swap requires at most two mismatches.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Uses zero-padding to handle different lengths and checks reciprocal transposition.
